title: 4x4 mesh, 16-node ALLREDUCE 1024B: independent RTL execution of the canonical trace

expected.notes: Ring oracle (independent): messages=2k(k-1)=480, bytes=2(k-1)B=30720, chunk=64, flits=4800, packets=960. VERITX's lowering must match the oracle; the RTL then independently executes the derived trace. Completion is injection-bound here (F-0003 hypothesis), so the network is not the bottleneck.
